In the rest frame of the glass (the medium) the speed of the light beam is  

u = c/n = 1/n.  

The glass itself moves with speed v (in the same direction as the beam) relative to the laboratory.  
To obtain the speed of the light beam relative to the laboratory we add the two collinear velocities relativistically:

u_lab = (u + v)/(1 + u v)
       = (1/n + v)/(1 + v/n).

Multiply numerator and denominator by n:

u_lab = (1 + n v)/(n + v).

This matches option (D).

Answer: D
